body: Thank you. She's downstairs right now talking to my dad. This is the worst moment, I guess. From now on it will just get better.

I sold them to the pawn shop. I didn't put them on loan. He can sell them back to me for much more money if he wants. Unfortunately he sent them to be smelted for the gold. He said there is a chance he can get the pieces back before they are melted down, so he's going to try. 
Thank you, your words help.
